shell.authLanding.expiredBody: Links work once and last 15 minutes.
shell.authLanding.unreachableBody: The link is still good — check your connection and try again.
shell.connect.any.name: Any client
shell.connect.any.note: The endpoint uses Streamable HTTP, not SSE. A GET request returns 405.
shell.connect.any.stepAdd: Add this server configuration and approve access when prompted.
shell.connect.any.stepClient: Use a client that supports Streamable HTTP and OAuth 2.1.
shell.connect.chatgpt.label: Server URL
shell.connect.chatgpt.note: Availability depends on your ChatGPT account and workspace settings.
shell.connect.chatgpt.stepCreate: Open Plugins and use the plus button to create a connection. Enter the settings above and a description, such as “Use Windmill from ChatGPT”.
shell.connect.chatgpt.stepDeveloperMode: In ChatGPT, open Settings → Security and login and enable Developer mode.
shell.connect.chatgpt.stepOAuth: Choose OAuth, then approve access to Windmill when prompted.
shell.connect.chatgpt.stepSelect: In a conversation, open the + menu → Developer mode and select Windmill.
shell.connect.code.label: Terminal
shell.connect.code.stepApprove: Approve access in the browser on first use.
shell.connect.code.stepRun: Run this command in your terminal.
shell.connect.codex.stepAdd: Add this configuration to ~/.codex/config.toml. Codex desktop, CLI, and IDE share these settings.
shell.connect.codex.stepLogin: Run codex mcp login windmill, or choose Authenticate in Codex’s MCP settings. Approve access in your browser.
shell.connect.codex.stepRestart: Restart Codex to load the configuration. In the CLI, use /mcp to check the server connection.
shell.connect.copyFailed: Couldn’t copy. Select the text above and copy it manually.
shell.connect.cursor.stepApprove: Approve access in the browser tab Cursor opens.
shell.connect.cursor.stepSave: Save this configuration, then enable Windmill under Cursor settings → MCP.
shell.connect.desktop.label: Connector URL
shell.connect.desktop.stepAdd: Add a custom connector named Windmill and paste the URL.
shell.connect.desktop.stepApprove: Approve access in the browser when prompted.
shell.connect.intro: Use your AI tools with Windmill.
shell.connect.keyNote: Use a Windmill API key only if your client cannot use OAuth. Keep it private, like a password.
shell.connect.manageKeys: Manage keys in Settings → API keys
shell.connect.oauthNote: OAuth opens your browser to approve access. No API key to paste.
shell.oauth.badRedirectBody: Where it wants to send you back doesn’t match what this app registered. For your safety, we won’t continue — start again from your MCP client.
shell.oauth.canDelete: Deleting is permanent — this tool can remove things you made. It can’t see your chats or read anything you didn’t grant above.
shell.oauth.cannotDelete: It can only do what’s listed above. It can’t see your chats, and nothing else in your account is reachable.
shell.oauth.everything: Everything in your account — every product, including deleting
shell.oauth.expiredBody: These links last about ten minutes. Start again from your MCP client and you’ll come right back.
shell.oauth.gateBody: Sign in to review the access your tool is requesting.
shell.oauth.malformedBody: The authorization link is missing something. Start again from your MCP client — it will send you back here with a fresh one.
shell.oauth.nothing: Nothing — this request names no part of your account
shell.oauth.redirectNote: Allowing sends you back to {host}. Only grant access to tools you trust — disconnect anytime in account settings.
shell.oauth.review: Review the access this tool is requesting.
shell.oauth.title: Connect {client}
shell.oauth.unknownClientBody: This link is for an application Windmill hasn’t seen register. Start again from your MCP client.
shell.oauth.unreachableBody: Check your connection and try again — nothing was authorized.
shell.switcher.label: Products
